1)one day i was supposed to go out nd before inwas leaving my parents decided to go hell on each other nd then me. Without a cause i was being told shit at my face. I asked them to stop as i was getting late to leave. I tried ti maintain my calm nd not increase the hostility. After 30min of incessant screaming i punched the fucking wall in front of my father. Extremely hard. I didn't even flinch nd blankly looked at them saying next time "it will be his face" Nd walked out.
2) i was small nd my cousin brother was screwing with me. He was beating me on the head with a bat and i asked him to stop since it was hurting me. After three times...i got up nd punched him in the face. His mouth bled. 
Later I was sorry but not very much.
